summary.text: Serenity Salak is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 93, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Democratic primary.
A teacher and caseworker from Saginaw Township, she says she is running on affordable child care and health care.

paragraphs.text: Salak earned a high school diploma from Birch Run High School and a bachelor's degree from Michigan State University in 2007, and her career experience includes working as a teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she studied political science, later earned a Master of Public Administration, and now lives in Saginaw Township.
She was among the candidates in the February 3, 2026 special Democratic primary for Michigan State Senate District 35, receiving 2.7 percent of the vote; Chedrick Greene won the primary.
Salak listed affordable child care, including a public before- and after-school option in every elementary school and permanent free school meals, and health care access as key campaign messages.
